assignments.name: subject
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Read invoice').item.json; const days = d.daysOverdue ?? d['Days post due date '] ?? 0; return 'Overdue: ' + d.id + ' - $' + d.amountRemaining + ' - ' + days + ' days'; })() }}

assignments.name: emailBody
assignments.value:
={{ (() => { const w = $('Webhook').item.json.body.emailBody; const d = $json.draftEmail; const body = (w && String(w).trim()) || (d && String(d).trim()) || ''; if (body) return body; return 'Hello ' + ($json.customer || 'there') + ',

This is a payment reminder from Dunnly AR for invoice ' + $json.id + ' with amount remaining ' + $json.amountRemaining + ' (' + ($json.daysOverdue || 0) + ' days overdue).

Please reply with the expected payment date.

Thank you,
Dunnly AR'; })() }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const isRetry = String($('Webhook').item.json.body.isRetry) === 'true'; if (isRetry) return 'no'; const stage = String($('Read invoice').item.json.stage || '').toLowerCase(); return ['sent','replied','classified','notified','failed'].includes(stage) ? 'yes' : 'no'; })() }}

={{ ($env.PA_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL && ($('Send via PA Gmail').item.json.statusCode === 200 || $('Send via PA Gmail').item.json.statusCode === 202) && !$('Send via PA Gmail').item.json.error) ? 'ok' : 'fail' }}

assignments.name: emailFailureReason
assignments.value: =PA Gmail send rejected: {{ JSON.stringify($('Send via PA Gmail').item.json.error || $('Send via PA Gmail').item.json.body || 'unknown').slice(0, 300) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ toEmail: $('Resolve payload').item.json.toEmail, To: $('Resolve payload').item.json.toEmail, email: $('Resolve payload').item.json.toEmail, subject: $('Resolve payload').item.json.subject, Subject: $('Resolve payload').item.json.subject, body: $('Resolve payload').item.json.emailBody, Body: $('Resolve payload').item.json.emailBody, invoiceId: $('Webhook').item.json.body.invoiceId, customer: $('Read invoice').item.json.customer || '' }) }}
